items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: now, how I got Walter Brown, I happened to be high one night

ctx.x: All right, now, let's hear a little bit about the band in Kansas City before you left to go to New York and we haven't discussed Walter Brown either.

Yes. Well, truthfully, before we went to New York, the big band, we -- when we made our first recordings, we went to Dallas, Texas. Walter Brown -- now, how I got Walter Brown, I happened to be high one night and I came through 18th Street and Walter Brown was singing the blues, and I listened to him sing the blues and I didn't have but 50 cents in my pocket and we were already scheduled to record for Decca. But I went back up to him and told him, I says, "Look, man, sing that song again." He sang that number…
So I went back to him, I says, "Look, I'll tell you what. You know I gave you my last 50 cents. Give me 25 cents back because I got to get me a bowl of chili." so he did.
